Hachiman Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefecture Shrine Office</ref>. {{nihongo|'''Hachiman Shrine (Otoi)'''|八幡神社 (伊豆市小土肥)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

== Overview ==
It is in the eastern inland area of Odoi at the northern end of the T?i district (former {{ill|Toi, Shizuoka|Q3530413|qid=Q3530413}}) in Izu City, along Prefectural Route 17 (Numazu-T?i Line).

Its founding is unknown, but it is identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} "Aotama-hime-no-Mikoto Shrine" and is an old shrine also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no kuni jinjaich?|ja|伊豆国神階帳|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "J?shi-i no J? Aotama-hime no My?jin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/hatiman4_title.htm Hachiman Shrine] - Genmatsushi</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140321-01.html Hachiman Shrine] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.

It was ranked as a village shrine in Meiji 6 ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}})<ref name="engi"/>.
